steps.what: Show the stored program proposed for review.
Review and approve programs or recommend modifications to existing programs.
Submitting program proposals for school board approval.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the program already on file. The education administrator reviews and approves the program or recommends modifications, and accepts the proposal. The screen does not approve a program. The {EMAIL} store submits only that accepted proposal for school board approval. The board decision sits outside this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: A program was treated as approved because a draft was on file, and neither the administrator nor the board had accepted it.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored program can be opened. The administrator still reviews it and accepts the proposal that is sent.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a program should change is still the administrator's judgement. The board's decision is still the board's.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator reviews, approves, or recommends the modification. The screen only sends the accepted proposal.
tasks.altitude: Approval of the program stays with the administrator. The board's decision stays outside this task.

reach.task: Receive a proposal this administrator has accepted.
reach.learn: A draft is not board approval.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored program is a lookup. It does not approve the program or modify it.
Approval of a school program is a person's decision. A screen must not approve it, and the board's decision sits outside the send.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An education administrator in a mid-size European school group. A stored record is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: The program id and the proposal text the administrator accepted. The screen does not approve a program. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the education administrator finishes it by hand.
Native check: Send a proposal only after the administrator has accepted that version.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the education administrator.
The screen does not approve a program. The school board's decision sits outside this task.
unknowns: Whether the board's later decision is written back into this program file.
research_questions: Which proposal version may be submitted, and who accepts it before the send?

already_counted.description: Reviewing and approving the program stays with the administrator.

incremental.description: Withdraw a proposal whose program record was closed.

approvals.approved_version: program proposal accepted by the education administrator

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The administrator still reviews and approves programs or recommends modifications, and still accepts the proposal. Only opening the stored program and submitting the accepted proposal is removed. The screen does not approve the program, and the school board's decision is not this task.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show named specialists, volunteers, and staff for these programs.
Organize and direct committees that provide technical and advisory assistance.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows specialists, volunteers, and staff already named for the program. The education administrator organizes and directs the committee and provides the technical and advisory assistance. The list is not a behaviour roster and it does not score anyone. A committee with no named people stays with the administrator.
tasks.previous_blocker: A committee was treated as directed because names were on a list, and the administrator had not met them.
tasks.enabler_now: Names already recorded can be shown. Directing the committee still has to happen in person.
tasks.still_hard: What the committee should advise is still said in the meeting, not by the list.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator organizes and directs the committee. The list only shows people already named.
tasks.altitude: Direction of the committee stays with the administrator. The named list is only visible.

reach.task: Give advice in the committee this administrator directs.
reach.learn: A name on a list is not a direction.

evidence.claim: Showing people already named is a lookup. It does not organize or direct the committee.
A list of names is not a behaviour roster and not a staff score. Directing the committee stays with the administrator.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An education administrator in a mid-size European school group. A stored record is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: Names already stored for the program. The screen does not add a person and does not score behaviour. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the education administrator finishes it by hand.
Native check: Show a person only when the name is already stored. Do not build a roster from behaviour.
unknowns: Whether volunteers and staff names share one list.
research_questions: Who may be named on the committee list before the administrator directs it?

already_counted.description: Organizing and directing the committee stays with the administrator.

incremental.description: Drop a name whose record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The administrator still organizes and directs committees of specialists, volunteers, and staff. Only showing names that were already stored is removed. The list does not direct the committee and does not score behaviour.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show stored extracurricular programs already on the calendar.
Coordinate and direct extracurricular activities, after-school events, and athletic contests.

tasks.design: The {CALENDAR} store shows extracurricular programs already listed. The education administrator coordinates and directs the activities, after-school events, and athletic contests. A scheduler that already places those events is not this labour. The list does not run the event. An event with no listing stays with the administrator.
tasks.previous_blocker: An event was treated as directed because it sat on a calendar, and the administrator had not coordinated it.
tasks.enabler_now: An event already listed can be opened. Coordinating and directing it still has to happen.
tasks.still_hard: How the event should run is still the administrator's direction, not the calendar line.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator coordinates and directs the event. The calendar only shows a listing already made.
tasks.altitude: Direction of the event stays with the administrator. A scheduler that already places events is not this labour.

reach.task: Run an event this administrator has directed.
reach.learn: A calendar line is not direction.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored event is a lookup. It does not coordinate or direct the event.
A scheduler that already places events is existing runtime. It is not labour saved from this administrator.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An education administrator in a mid-size European school group. A stored record is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: The event id and the listing already stored. The screen does not direct the event and does not roster staff from behaviour. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the education administrator finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the listing before the administrator directs the event. Do not credit a scheduler that already runs.
unknowns: Whether athletic contests and other after-school events share one calendar.
research_questions: Who directs an event when the administrator is not present?

already_counted.description: Coordinating and directing the events stays with the administrator.

incremental.description: Drop an event whose listing has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The administrator still coordinates and directs extracurricular activities, after-school events, and athletic contests. Only opening a listing that was already stored is removed. A scheduler that already places those events is not this labour.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Draft publication sentences only from held notes.

loop.input: Notes the administrator already holds about facilities and programs.
loop.output: Draft sentences that restate only what those notes state.
loop.check: Each sentence cites a note id and states only a line that note states.
loop.stop: No note id, or the sentence states a line the note does not.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed paragraph cannot tell which line is not in the held note.

steps.what: Write articles, manuals, and other publications about facilities and programs.
Assist distribution of the accepted promotional literature.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store drafts sentences only from notes the education administrator already holds about facilities and programs. The administrator writes the articles, manuals, and other publications and accepts the text. A sentence is kept only when the note states it. The {EMAIL} store then assists distribution of that accepted promotional literature. The screen does not invent the text.
tasks.previous_blocker: Promotional literature went out with a sentence no note stated, and the administrator had not accepted the text.
tasks.enabler_now: A held note can be restated. The administrator still writes the publication and accepts the text.
tasks.still_hard: What the school should say about a facility is still the administrator's writing, not a sentence the note does not state.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator writes and accepts the publication. The draft may only restate a held note.
tasks.altitude: Writing stays with the administrator. Distribution sends only the accepted text.

reach.task: Receive the publication this administrator accepted.
reach.learn: A draft sentence is not the publication.

evidence.claim: A sentence can be drafted from a note the administrator already holds. It cannot add a line the note does not state.
Distribution of promotional literature is a send of the accepted text. It is not permission to invent that text.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An education administrator in a mid-size European school group. A stored record is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: A held note id and the line that note states. A sentence with no note id is dropped. The screen does not invent promotional text. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the education administrator finishes it by hand.
Native check: Keep a sentence only when the held note states it. Send only the version the administrator accepted.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the education administrator.
A sentence is kept only when the held note states it. The screen does not invent promotional text.
unknowns: Whether articles, manuals, and promotional literature share one note file.
research_questions: Which note may be used as a source before a publication is distributed?

already_counted.description: Writing and accepting the publication stays with the administrator.

incremental.description: Retire a publication whose source note was withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: publication accepted by the education administrator

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The administrator still writes articles, manuals, and other publications and still accepts the text. Only drafting a sentence that a held note already states, and distributing the accepted literature, is removed. A sentence the note does not state is not kept.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The education administrator still approves programs, still directs committees, still runs extracurricular events, and still writes the publications. A stored list can be opened. It does not do that work.
reach: The school board receives a proposal only after this administrator has accepted it.
Readers receive promotional literature only in the version this administrator accepted.
skills_to_grow: Approve a program as the administrator's own decision. The screen does not approve it.
Direct the committee in person. A list of names is not that direction.
Write the publication from notes already held. The screen does not invent a sentence.
role.ambitious_version: Program approval, committee direction, events, and publications stay with the administrator. A stored name or note only shows what a person already recorded.
